status: Original educational prototype; not psychometrically validated

dimensions.name: Processing style
dimensions.definition: How someone develops an initial understanding or position.
dimensions.boundary: This describes preferred processing, not sociability, confidence, or intelligence.

dimensions.name: Attention style
dimensions.definition: Where attention goes first when making sense of something.
dimensions.boundary: This describes a starting point, not accuracy, creativity, or strategic ability.

dimensions.name: Planning style
dimensions.definition: How early someone prefers to establish a sequence and commitments.
dimensions.boundary: This describes preferred structure, not reliability or organizational skill.

dimensions.name: Action style
dimensions.definition: How someone reduces uncertainty before an initial move.
dimensions.boundary: This describes approach at comparable stakes, not courage, impulsivity, or risk tolerance.

dimensions.name: Collaboration style
dimensions.definition: How someone prefers to distribute thinking and ownership on suitable tasks.
dimensions.boundary: This describes work arrangement, not teamwork ability or willingness to help.

dimensions.name: Communication style
dimensions.definition: How someone prefers to open a substantive message or conversation.
dimensions.boundary: This describes sequencing, not honesty, empathy, assertiveness, or kindness. Context and relationship are distinct facets; report a split when they diverge.

dimensions.name: Change preference
dimensions.definition: How much method variety someone prefers when the current approach is adequate.
dimensions.boundary: This describes preference at comparable cost, not adaptability, ambition, or resistance to improvement.

dimensions.name: Execution style
dimensions.definition: How someone prefers to arrange attention across manageable work.
dimensions.boundary: This describes work rhythm, not productivity, attention disorders, or ability to finish.

archetypes.name: The Deliberate Builder
archetypes.description: May enjoy giving an idea structure, understanding the route, and progressing through focused work.
archetypes.possible_overuse: Preparation can continue after enough information is available.
archetypes.experiment: Set a small information threshold and a date for a reversible first attempt.

archetypes.name: The Adaptive Explorer
archetypes.description: May enjoy exploring possibilities while allowing the route to evolve.
archetypes.possible_overuse: Options can remain open longer than a shared commitment allows.
archetypes.experiment: Choose one exploration window and one explicit decision point.

archetypes.name: The Collaborative Catalyst
archetypes.description: May develop momentum by thinking with others and establishing shared context.
archetypes.possible_overuse: Progress can become dependent on access to other people.
archetypes.experiment: Pair a short joint discussion with one clearly owned next action.

archetypes.name: The Independent Architect
archetypes.description: May enjoy developing broader concepts through private thinking and clear ownership.
archetypes.possible_overuse: A developed idea may reach collaborators too late for useful input.
archetypes.experiment: Share a rough outline at an agreed early checkpoint.

archetypes.name: The Practical Navigator
archetypes.description: May prefer concrete information, clear messages, and flexibility in the route.
archetypes.possible_overuse: An immediate next step can obscure a dependency that needs advance coordination.
archetypes.experiment: State the next step and name one dependency before proceeding.

archetypes.name: The Possibility Connector
archetypes.description: May enjoy connecting emerging possibilities through shared exploration.
archetypes.possible_overuse: Interesting connections can create more simultaneous commitments than intended.
archetypes.experiment: Capture new possibilities in a backlog and jointly select one to test.

archetypes.name: The Focused Finisher
archetypes.description: May prefer a clear plan, defined ownership, and sustained attention through a useful stopping point.
archetypes.possible_overuse: Protecting focus can delay feedback or adjustment.
archetypes.experiment: Add one feedback checkpoint before the final work block. The label does not establish completion ability.

archetypes.name: The Experimental Maker
archetypes.description: May enjoy learning through concrete attempts and alternative methods.
archetypes.possible_overuse: Repeated experiments can make it hard to retain lessons or stabilize a useful method.
archetypes.experiment: Define one observable test result and record it before starting the next test.

selection.core_rule: One item from pool A and one from pool B for every dimension; distinct context tags; COM one odd and one even item to cover both facets.

closing_prompt: What important part of how you work have we missed?
